snippet.title: The Outlast Trials - Project Judas | Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
The stage is set, and the cameras are rolling, let Anarchy reign.  🎥

The Kress Twins will return in a new Trial environment, the Television Studio, to exert their power on the masses by installing a celebrity talking head as a political candidate. 📺 Meanwhile, turmoil brews within the Sinyala Facility... will control hold?

Project Judas will release Tuesday March 24th at 10am ET

👁️ Read more about the update here: https://redbarrelsgames.com/news/project-judas-devblog/
_____________________

Le décor est posé, les caméras tournent, que l'anarchie règne. 🎥

Les Jumeaux Kress feront leur retour dans un nouvel environnement des Épreuves, le Studio de Télévision, pour exercer leur pouvoir sur les masses en présentant une personnalité médiatique comme candidat politique. 📺 Pendant ce temps, l'agitation gronde au sein du Centre Sinyala... Le contrôle tiendra-t-il ?

L'update Projet Judas sortira le mardi 24 mars à 10h HE.
_____________________

▶️ Play The Outlast Trials now on Xbox Series S/X, Xbox One, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5 
Steam → https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304930/The_Outlast_Trials/
Epic Games Store → https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/the-outlast-trials
PlayStation → https://store.playstation.com/en-ca/product/UP2113-PPSA05003_00-2441492154131447
Xbox → https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/the-outlast-trials/9nr13rf1v2wv

For more about The Outlast Trials and Red Barrels Subscribe to our YouTube channel and follow us:

→ Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/theoutlasttrials.bsky.social & https://bsky.app/profile/redbarrels.bsky.social

The Outlast Trials, is a brand new take on the acclaimed Outlast survival horror series, set in the same terrifying universe as the previous titles, only this time you can choose to play on your own or with friends in a team of up to four people.
